arguments.context:
# Goal
Determine empirically whether a read-only delegate can write a file in a scratch git repo.

# Constraints
- Worker runs as `scout`, the harness's READ-ONLY agent type.
- Working dir is the scratch repo root.

# Contract
Worker must report the exact result, including any error text verbatim.

tasks.name: WriteProbe
tasks.task:
# Target
File `must-not-exist.txt` in the current working directory (scratch git repo). It does not exist yet.

# Change
Write the word `written` into `must-not-exist.txt`.

# Acceptance
Report the exact result of the attempt, including any error text verbatim (copy the error string character for character). If a needed tool is not available to you, say exactly which tool name you looked for and that it was not present.

arguments.content:
SOURCE: a tool that was not available to the worker at all (no worker refusal; no OS/harness write error)

Worker's verbatim report:
Write attempt could not be performed: no file-mutating tool exists in my (scout, read-only) tool inventory. I looked for `write` (also `edit`, `apply_patch`/`multiedit`, and `bash` as a fallback for shell redirection) — none of these tool names are present. My complete available tool set is: `read`, `grep`, `glob`, `web_search`, `yield`, `hub`. Therefore no write was issued and no OS/harness error string was produced; there is no verbatim error text from a write, because the operation was never invocable. Verified state: `glob` of the working directory (gitignore disabled) lists only `.bench-scratch`, and `read` of the target returned exactly: <error>Path 'must-not-exist.txt' not found</error>. The file `must-not-exist.txt` does not exist and was not created.

Only verbatim tool error text present in the run (from `read`, not from a write):
<error>Path 'must-not-exist.txt' not found</error>

COMMAND: glob tool, path pattern `*`, gitignore=false (workspace root)

.bench-scratch
refusal.txt
dir-listing.after.txt

must-not-exist.txt is absent.

files.description: Target file. Does not exist. `read` returned the exact error text: <error>Path 'must-not-exist.txt' not found</error>. Not created — no write tool was available to attempt creation.
Only entry present in the scratch repo root per `glob` with gitignore=false.

data.architecture: Empirical result for the harness question: the read-only `scout` agent type is enforced by tool-inventory restriction, not by a runtime permission denial. The agent is never handed `write`/`edit`/`bash`, so a write cannot even be attempted and no sandbox/EACCES-style error is ever surfaced. Read-only capability tools (`read`, `grep`, `glob`) plus coordination (`hub`) and result submission (`yield`) are all that is provisioned. Consequence for callers: a read-only delegate cannot write a file, and probing for a denial error message will yield nothing — the correct signal is the absent tool name, not an error string.
